claim_text: Three defendants in case 22-CR-223, previously listed in this corpus only as 'charged' as of their original 2022-09-20 charge date, pleaded guilty per a Hiiraan Online tracker: Abdulkadir Nur Salah (co-owner of Safari Restaurant) pleaded guilty to one count of wire fraud, admitted to $16 million in fraudulent funds received by Safari, and agreed to pay $5.5 million in restitution with a recommended sentence of 9 to 11.5 years; Abdi Nur Salah (a former aide to Minneapolis Mayor Jacob Frey) pleaded guilty to one count of wire fraud, admitted pocketing more than $1 million via his nonprofit Stigma Free International, and agreed to a recommended sentence of roughly two years; Abdikadir Ainanshe Mohamud ('AK'), who ran the Stigma-Free Willmar food site at FaaFan Restaurant, pleaded guilty to one count of wire fraud, admitted siphoning more than $5 million, and agreed to a recommended sentence of roughly four to five years. None of the three has a confirmed sentencing outcome in this pass.
